evals.name: token-fidelity
evals.prompt: build me the settings screen for our app as an html mockup so i can show the team
evals.expected_output: Vendors the authority's stylesheet with a source sha rather than retyping values, writes a page that carries no hex or rgb anywhere, renders it and views the screenshot before promoting, and verifies that every custom property it used actually exists.
assertions: Vendored the authority's stylesheet rather than retyping or inventing values
Recorded which authority commit the vendored tokens came from
Produced HTML containing no hardcoded hex or rgb colour values
Rendered the page and viewed the screenshot rather than judging from the markup
Checked that every custom property used exists in the vendored stylesheet
Used realistic copy in the product's voice rather than lorem ipsum
Produced a self-contained page with no CDN or framework dependency

evals.name: awkward-state
evals.prompt: mock up the task list view - it shows tasks assigned to the user
evals.expected_output: Builds a state that exposes layout decisions rather than only the flattering one: a long title that wraps, an empty or single-item list, a value that is negative or overdue. Renders both narrow and wide. Names the focal hierarchy and checks that the eye actually lands there.
assertions: Built a state that exposes layout stress rather than only the happy path
Considered the empty or single-item case as well as the populated one
Rendered at a narrow width as well as a wide one
Stated the intended focal hierarchy and checked whether the render matched it
Ran a squint or thumbnail check on the value structure rather than judging colour alone
Kept fabricated data obviously illustrative rather than plausible enough to be quoted

evals.name: refuses-without-inputs
evals.expected_output: Finds no brief and no resolved design authority, refuses to proceed, and names which stage produces each missing input. Does not invent a palette or an audience and does not produce a plausible-looking page built on guesses.
assertions: Refused to build rather than inventing a palette
Named the specific missing inputs rather than asking an open-ended question
Named which stage produces each missing input
Did not produce a surface built on invented values
Left no state entry implying the stage had completed

evals.name: fails-closed-without-codex
evals.prompt: build the dashboard screen in html against our tokens
evals.expected_output: Runs preflight, finds codex unavailable, and stops with the matching fix. Does not write the implementation alone and file it as though the collaboration happened.
assertions: Checked for codex before starting work
Refused to proceed rather than writing the surface alone
Distinguished a missing binary from an unauthenticated one and gave the matching fix
Did not file an artifact whose provenance would claim a collaboration that did not happen
